title: Cardiovascular History and Hemodynamic Complications After Intubation in ICU
official: Impact of Cardiovascular History on the Incidence of Severe Hemodynamic Complications Following Intubation in Intensive Care Units
summary: This retrospective single-center observational study aims to evaluate the association between a history of cardiovascular disease and the occurrence of severe hemodynamic complications within 30 minutes after intubation in adult patients admitted to the intensive care unit. Cardiovascular history includes ischemic, arrhythmic, dilated or valvular heart disease, pulmonary hypertension, and systemic hypertension. Severe hemodynamic complications include severe hypotension, initiation or increase of norepinephrine, fluid resuscitation for hemodynamic instability, or cardiac arrest.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient aged 18 years or older
* Patient hospitalized in intensive care unit between 01/01/2024 and 30/09/2025
* Patient requiring intubation in intensive care unit
* Absence of documented opposition to data reuse for research

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient intubated for cardiac arrest
* Patient intubated outside intensive care unit
* Patient intubated under awake fiberoptic technique
* Patient under legal protection (guardianship or curatorship)
